welcome.label: Assignment received
welcome.text: Welcome to HILFER. Your current assignment is Post-Incident Data Reconciliation. The Consolidated Report is ready for review.

voice.text: Good to see you. The consolidated report is ready whenever you are.

investigating.label: Review pending
investigating.text: Your personnel review remains open. Departmental sources are available in Records; Reconciliation maintains the consolidated entry. No revision has been filed.

voice.text: Still comparing sources? Take your time. The entry is still open.

filed.label: Report updated
filed.text: The work-status entry for Jessica has been revised in the Consolidated Report. Its source references have been retained. The recorded work-related cause has not changed.

voice.text: I have your revision. The report now reflects your decision.
